quote.translation: A second example: "Mr Masuda Jirō, president of Shōwa Electric Power, was summoned to the Tokyo District Court on the morning of the twenty-sixth and, after a lengthy examination by Prosecutor Kanazawa, was further subjected to detention questioning by Preliminary Judge Yamaguchi, and at six in the afternoon, on a charge of official corruption, he was committed to Ichigaya Prison under compulsory measures prior to indictment.

regions.text: 強制處外で市ヶ谷刑務所に收容された。聞くところによると同氏は過般來警頑應並に檢事局で取調べを進めてゐた昭電疑獄の療考人として最初は昭電事件係中島檢事の取調べを受けたる際側然にも買動事件に深い開係のあることを同檢事に摑まれ、それがため改めて買動事件係金澤檢事の調べ室に廻されたものである』大阪朝日新聞税和四4九月ニ十七日）。

quote.translation: It is reported that he was first examined as a witness in the Shōden scandal, which the Metropolitan Police Board and the Public Prosecutor's Office had for some time been investigating, by Prosecutor Nakajima, in charge of the Shōden case, and that in the course of this examination his deep involvement in the decorations-buying affair was by chance uncovered by the same prosecutor, so that he was sent on anew to the examination room of Prosecutor Kanazawa, in charge of the decorations-buying affair" (Ōsaka Asahi Shinbun, 27 September 1929).

regions.text: 初めに取調べた檢事は昭電事件を取調べるのが唯一の目的であったこそれ故に買動事件に開する發見は全く日的外のものとして偶然と云はれるのである。

quote.translation: The prosecutor who first examined him had as his sole purpose the investigation of the Shōden case, and the discovery concerning the decorations-buying affair, falling wholly outside that purpose, is consequently called chance.

regions.text: 一方に昭電事件の取調べと他方に買動事件の取調べとは全く獨立した二つの目約々系列をなしてゐた。この雨系列間に全く目約としなかつた新しい積極約開係が立てられたのである。

quote.translation: The investigation of the Shōden case on the one side and the investigation of the decorations-buying affair on the other formed two entirely independent teleological series, and between these two series a new positive relation was established that neither had aimed at in any way.

regions.text: なほ一例を擧げれば、昭和九年九月十日の東京放送局ラチォ放選番組の演發放送は全部大阪放送局からの中機であつたが「偶然が生んだこの番組」としてその日の新開に論議された。

quote.translation: To give one more example: on 10 September 1934 the entertainment broadcasts in the radio programme of the Tokyo Broadcasting Station were all relayed from the Osaka Broadcasting Station, and that day's newspaper discussed this as "this programme born of chance".

regions.text: 先づ事實が述べてある。「今日は書の獨唱と管校楽」を初め夜の「義太夫」と「落語」など、演藝放選は全部大阪からの中織でこのところAK文藝部本日休業といふかたちであるこれは全く偶熱にかうした番粗が細成さ

quote.translation: The paper first states the facts: "Today, beginning with the afternoon 'Solo Song and Orchestral Music', and including the evening 'Gidayū' and 'Rakugo', the entertainment broadcasts are all relayed from Osaka, so that it takes the form of 'AK literary and arts department closed today'.

regions.text: ちであるこれは全く偶熱にかうした番粗が細成さ

quote.translation: The AK authorities say that this programme was arranged entirely by chance, but that since the programme arrangement committee decided it thus, nothing can be done about it."
